title: Giganto Maxia
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: One hundred million years after the Great Destruction, the Empire of Olympus uses colossal beasts to crush its enemies across the wastelands. The gladiator Delos and the young mystic Prome, who together become the titan Gohra, set out to stop the bloodshed and heal the planet. It is a single-volume story by the creator of Berserk.
life_message: Strength should serve compassion: protect the weak, stop genocide and heal a wounded world.

content.note: War, giant beasts and wrestling battles; Otaku USA notes violent content (via Wikipedia); AniList Kaiju and MU War tags.
Genocide threat and colossal monsters (publisher blurb, Wikipedia).
